# openstatus_status_page (Resource)

Manages a status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openstatus_status_page" "main" {
  title          = "Example Status Page"
  slug           = "example-status"
  description    = "Status page for Example Inc."
  homepage_url   = "https://example.com"
  contact_url    = "https://example.com/contact"
  theme          = "dark"
  default_locale = "en"
  locales        = ["en", "fr"]
  allow_index    = true
}

resource "openstatus_status_page" "internal" {
  title             = "Internal Status"
  slug              = "internal-status"
  access_type       = "ip"
  allowed_ip_ranges = "10.0.0.0/8,192.168.0.0/16"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String)
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `access_type` (String) Access type of the status page. One of: `public`, `password`, `email-domain`, `ip`.
- `allow_index` (Boolean)
- `allowed_ip_ranges` (String) Comma-separated IPv4 CIDR ranges. Required when `access_type` is `ip`.
- `auth_email_domains` (List of String) List of email domains allowed to access the page. Used when `access_type` is `email-domain`.
- `contact_url` (String)
- `custom_domain` (String) Custom domain for the status page. DNS must point to OpenStatus before setting this.
- `default_locale` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `homepage_url` (String)
- `icon` (String) URL of the icon to display on the status page.
- `locales` (List of String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password to protect the status page. Required when `access_type` is `password`.
- `theme` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `published` (Boolean)
- `updated_at` (String)
